scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm ci --ignore-scripts && cd ../frontend && npm ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test -- --watch=false
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix backend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend run e2e
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint:check
